_comment: Package names from the IGDS monorepo root package.json (nx publish targets). Each value is either a plain package name, using the default import shape for that framework, or { package, import, ... } with a template. Templates support {component} (PascalCase name), {package}, {tag} (igds-accordion-item) and {path} (accordion-item). Optional per-entry keys: pathOverrides maps a tag to its real export subpath; childrenUseParentPath makes child elements (TableRow) import from their parent's subpath (table). A template that uses {path} falls back to the package root for components with no tag. Re-run `npm run build:docs` after editing.

core-web._note: Verified against @igds/core-web 0.1.37 package.json#exports: one side-effect entry per component (./button, ./table, ...). Importing the package root registers every component, which defeats tree-shaking.

react._note: Verified against @igds/react 0.1.37 package.json#exports: per-component subpaths (./button, ./table, ...), each exporting the component and its children (Table, TableHeader, TableRow from ./table).

angular._note: Confirmed from an IGDS Storybook usage sample: standalone components, deep-imported per component, then listed in the consuming component's `imports: [...]` array.
